tweet.text: Lately in autoresearch, the one that stood out to me is Arbor (http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11926), it runs the whole loop as a hypothesis tree. One thing I'd like to try: their insights only flow up the lineage to ancestors, so sibling branches never share, they get compared but not stitched together. If we add embedding-based edges over the hypothesis descriptions, related nodes in different branches could trade lessons sideways, not just upward. Would be interesting to measure how much it actually helps. recommend
